state.background: The user asked to verify pre-push readiness, then clarified that E2E should simply be replaced with Browser Mode. The implementation replaces the hook's E2E cleanup/test stage with the already existing production-route Browser Mode aggregate. Both full and changed profiles build first; `test:browser:next-route-poc:built` then uses the runner that requires `.next/BUILD_ID`, starts its own production server, runs B01-B14/next-route/WebKit, and tears the server down. The direct `test:e2e` command is unchanged and remains available. Only `.husky/pre-push.bash`, `scripts/hook-smoke.mjs`, and `tests/unit/husky-push-impact.test.ts` were edited for this cutover. The previous zero-test wrapper plan and its unresolved JEV first result are retained as superseded history; a new direct-replacement plan passed JEV.
acceptanceCriteria: Full and changed-file pre-push profiles run the production-route Browser Mode aggregate after build succeeds.
The pre-push hook does not run Playwright E2E or E2E port cleanup.
The hook smoke and push-impact unit test enforce exact gate order, absence of E2E gates, and failure short-circuiting.
verification: The revised plan passed JEV as valid_as_defined; see results/plan45/phase6/jev-prepush-browser-mode-cutover-plan-result.json.
`pnpm run test:hook-smoke` passed with initial, normal, docs-only skip, multi-ref, deletion, failure atomicity, full-profile, and Browser Mode failure/fallback checks.
`pnpm exec vitest run tests/unit/husky-push-impact.test.ts` passed: 1 file, 10 tests. Printed Node diagnostics are emitted by the deliberate simulated failing-gate fixture; the test command exited 0.
`pnpm run lint:fast` exited 0 and `git diff --check` exited 0 after the latest hook-smoke fix.

The existing build plus Browser Mode production-route aggregate passed earlier in this worktree: production build/type stage passed, B01-B14 37 passed, production-route 80 passed, WebKit 21 passed / 5 skipped. Log: results/plan45/phase6/phase6-tooltip-231-browser-mode-validation-2026-09-27.log.

Read-only review confirmed the active Husky hooksPath. Pre-commit runs lint:fast, conditional staged-file tsgo, and lint-staged; no hooks were bypassed. The pre-push hook itself was not invoked because it would run the full validation profile during a commit request; its command contract is exercised by smoke and unit tests.
knownConstraints: The full pre-push validation profile has not been run after this hook-only change; no push was requested.
The shared worktree contains broad previously authorized Plan45 changes. Stage only the intended project work and exclude generated Browser Mode attachment/screenshot/trace outputs.

Prior JEV wrapper-plan initial and automatic-clarification results remain unresolved historical records and are superseded by the user's direct Browser Mode instruction and the passing replacement plan review.
